# Generated JNI headers — do not edit

This committed snapshot is the immutable base-release JNI-header input for Realm Java
v10.19.0. It was generated from the upstream Realm Java native Java declarations with
JDK 17.0.19 (`javac 17.0.19`) using the actual base-release Java compilation and
`javac -h`; it is not regenerated by normal builds.

## Provenance

- Upstream Java declaration tree: `realm-library/src/main/java`
- Source-tree digest (sorted per-file SHA-256 list): `a014f88ec10a30b2aebe61152ed9275b0121aa1946f2e5d2b46c4529996ba4fe`
- Reproduce that digest:

  ```sh
  find realm/realm-library/src/main/java -type f -name '*.java' -print0 \
    | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
  ```

- Generator JDK: Homebrew OpenJDK 17.0.19+0 (`java.vendor=Homebrew`,
  `java.home=/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/openjdk@17/17.0.19/libexec`)
- Generator executable: `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/openjdk@17/17.0.19/libexec/bin/javac`
- Header manifest: `SHA256SUMS` (30 files)
- Header source declaration list: `SOURCE_NATIVE_DECLARATIONS.txt`
- Header-generation command:

  ```sh
  ./realm/gradlew -p realm --no-daemon --console=plain \
    :realm-library:compileBaseReleaseJavaWithJavac
  ```

The Stage 5 build config directs that real Java compile's `-h` output to a separate
variant-specific validation directory. `verifyBaseReleaseJniHeaders` compares its
inventory and bytes with this snapshot after the public base AAR is built. The CMake
consumer receives only a copied staging directory under `build/`; neither this
snapshot nor its provenance files are AAR inputs.

To intentionally update this snapshot, regenerate from the recorded upstream source
and JDK, verify the exact 30-file manifest and byte parity, then update this README,
`SHA256SUMS`, and the snapshot in one reviewed change.
